description: Read the billed usage of the last up to 14 UTC days (today included) grouped by day, project and meter, and what each project has used so far this UTC month. One credit is 1000000 microcredits. Null environment means shared project cost. Charges can arrive late and unmetered usage is not zero consumption. Owner-only; works at zero credit without new charges.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: organization_usage_get
